name: AI model hosts
question: Is running AI models becoming a commodity?
metric: Services on models.dev listing the most widely listed model, at the start of the month
solvedIf: Top models are sold by so many services that price is all that differs
trendLabel: Services listing the most widely listed model on models.dev, at the start of each month.
caution: The catalogue itself grew fast, so much of this rise is models.dev adding services, not new services appearing.
Models are matched across services by name, so the same model under different names counts separately. A listing does not show how much a service is used.
rule: More hosts when the top model is listed by more services than the top model a year before.

analysis.title: Most widely listed models
analysis.intro: The catalogue itself grew from 57 to 237 services in a year, so the top model's share went from 30% to 34%.
